outline:
讓同學了解電磁學之基本觀念與應用，全學年課程內容將包括：
上學期：1.向量分析 2.靜電學 3.電位與邊界值問題 4.靜磁學 5.物質內的電、磁場
下學期：5.電磁感應與時變場 6.守恆律 7.電磁波特性與傳播行為 8.電磁波的反射與穿透
schedule:
week 1~2: Review of Magnetostatics
week 2~4: Magnetic Fields in Matter
week 4~9: Electrodynamics
(week 8 or 9: midterm exam.)
week 10~11: Conservation Laws
week 11~14 Electromagnetic Waves
week 15~17: EM Waves at Boundaries
week 18: final exam.
assessment:
quizzes: 15% x 2
midterm: 25%
final: 25%
homeworks and homework tests: 20%
participation: extra 10%
materials:
【遵守智慧財產權觀念，請使用正版教科書，不得使用非法影印教科書】

使用外文原文書：是

main text: Introduction to Electrodynamics, 4th ed., by David J. Griffiths
for applications and practices: Field and Wave Electromagnetics, 2nd ed., by David K. Cheng
sdgs: SDG7：可負擔的潔淨能源（Affordable and Clean Energy）
